question: How many cells do large animals have?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Billions**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Animals consist of millions of millions i.e. **Billions of cells.**
 
• Humans consist of more than 40 trillion cells.
 
• Every animal's cell has an important function that helps it survive and thrive.
 
• Animal cells are made up of several parts, called organelles, that work together and enable the cell to function.
 
• An animal cell is eukaryotic in nature.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Animal cells consist of genes that code for particular proteins and mRNA and thus control the cell functions.
 
• It contains outer cell membranes and membrane-bound organelles.
 
• The animal cell does not have any cell wall.
 
• It contains membrane-bound organelles such as mitochondria, Endoplasmic reticulum, Golgi, and lysosomes.
 
• It consists of a nucleus and it is present inside the double membrane.
 
• The nucleus is centrally located.
 
• It has Nuclear pores that allow the diffusion of a substance through it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c562a0d77d69a074b0278617ca46ebc9336cf57c3677804edbec719b0bb502d2.png]
